items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The code is short and clear, but the message is misleading. `raise ValueError("Cannot filter a query once a slice has been taken.")` fires at Prefetch construction, where no filtering happens. The added test also leaves an extra blank line inside the class body.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: The nested `if queryset is not None:` block is small and tidy. But the guard sits in Prefetch.__init__ and does not fix the related_descriptors prefetch paths. It blocks a feature users want, so it would have to be removed later.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: It fails early at the boundary, so nothing is silently swallowed. However, it raises ValueError where QuerySet.filter raises TypeError for the same message. It also rejects valid use cases instead of handling them.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: No per-parent slicing is implemented. The fix only adds `if queryset.query.is_sliced: raise ValueError(...)`. There is no Window/RowNumber partitioning and no high_mark handling. All 4 PrefetchLimitTests fail.
